sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: IT consultant and software engineer working at the intersection of business and technology. I have been building software for over 15 years, first through volunteer open-source and community projects and professionally since 2019. My focus is on eliciting business requirements, analyzing business processes, and translating them together with clients into workable technical solutions - from requirements engineering and user stories through database and architecture design to project leadership. Over the last two years I have introduced AI into real work and development workflows in a hands-on way: designing AI workflows and agents, engineering prompts, and integrating LLMs productively (OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, MCP). I like to understand a system end-to-end, measure the results, and keep improving it. Currently deepening AI strategy and governance (incl. the EU AI Act) and workshop facilitation.

items.title: AI-Assisted Software Development
bullets: Core contributor (top 3 of a ~7-person team) on an existing greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) platform; responsible for specific components end-to-end rather than the overall architecture.

Requirements clarification, design, and delivery of the external REST API (API Platform) with a multi-tenant, permission-scoped access model (tenant isolation, Sanctum tokens) and OpenAPI documentation as the interface to third-party systems.

Designed and implemented the real-time synchronization mechanism via pivot events (Mercure/SSE) within an event-driven architecture; the underlying open-source contribution was a self-authored extension to a Laravel package.

Integrated AI into daily development and built an internal AI-assisted code-audit toolset (Claude Code slash-commands/subagents with deterministic verification) for soft-delete, CRUD-logging, and field-permission audits.

items.title: Application Development & Project Coordination
bullets: Determined customer needs and derived the necessary measures; conceived requirements-appropriate custom software.
Wrote user stories together with the development team and clients; formulated programming tasks and handed them over to the team.
Led and coordinated projects across online marketing, web design, and programming; reviewed and approved programming projects.
Analyzed business processes and conditions at the customer / in the respective application department and assured quality; planned, built, and optimized the database systems.
Communicated directly with clients and used AI tools productively in daily development; rated top grade in the employment reference.

items.title: Development & Team Coordination
bullets: Long-term team development of a large PHP browser game; modernizing a historically-grown codebase toward Symfony and Doctrine ORM.
Coordinated a ~10-person team and aligned technical and organizational tasks; documented processes and game rules (MediaWiki).

items.title: IT Mentor (volunteer)
bullets: Mentor women entering or re-entering IT; share development experience and guide them through starting their careers.

items.title: AI Engineering Experiments
bullets: Built and evaluated AI workflows, agents, and integrations to move from prompt experiments toward practical, production-oriented use of LLMs.
Designed agent workflows and orchestrated multi-step tasks with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP.
Optimized prompts and token usage, weighing cost against output quality; compared model strengths to choose the right model per task.

items.title: Trading Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Designed and built an algorithmic trading and backtesting system in Python on the event-driven NautilusTrader framework, including walk-forward validation and Monte Carlo simulation.
Performance engineering: evaluated very large parameter spaces via vectorization and JIT compilation (NumPy, Numba) instead of brute-force loops.
Built a distributed signal-trading system (FastAPI dashboard, multiple Docker containers, MetaTrader 5 integration) with risk management and extensive test coverage (pytest).

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events - custom-IDs feature (open-source contribution)
bullets: Extended an existing open-source Laravel package with support for custom IDs and timestamps on pivot tables; worked within its Eloquent relationship internals (BelongsToMany/MorphToMany, model events).
